parsed.main_gap: A sign error in the lower-inequality expansion makes (5) unjustified as written, though correcting that single sign completes the proof.

errors.description: The expansion has the displacement difference reversed. It should be (t-y)^2+4(t+c)(c-b). With this correction, the asserted bound b-c≤(t-y)^2/[4(t+c)] follows and the rest of the proof is valid.

parsed.notes: This is an essentially complete solution with one straightforwardly repairable algebraic sign typo. The iterate argument, constancy deduction, and converse are otherwise correct.
